items.question: Which supplier will win the most contracts next year?
items.sql: SELECT suppliers.supplier_id, suppliers.supplier_name, SUM(awards.amount_usd) AS total_awarded_usd FROM awards JOIN suppliers ON awards.supplier_id = suppliers.supplier_id JOIN tenders ON awards.tender_id = tenders.tender_id WHERE tenders.release_date BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' GROUP BY suppliers.supplier_id, suppliers.supplier_name ORDER BY total_awarded_usd DESC LIMIT 1
